follow-up time: From the beginning of pregnancy to delivery
cohort: 2,866 Syrian migrant women who gave birth at a tertiary center between January 2016 and May 2020
finding: Vitamin D supplementation during pregnancy was associated with a lower need for blood transfusion and a reduced rate of preterm birth among Syrian migrant women.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at birth was 38.06 ± 2.1 weeks
birth_weight: Mean newborn birth weight was 3.151 g
